title: Org Access Concierge: weighted intake pipeline and response runbook for RBAC/SSO/SCIM requests
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Goal: Build a repeatable, policy-driven intake pipeline (the 'Org Access Concierge') that classifies and prioritizes incoming admin/access requests (RBAC changes, SSO/SAML onboarding, SCIM provisioning issues, org policy exceptions) and returns consistent, SLA-backed responses and next steps to customers.

Why this exists:
- We see rising volume of manual admin tickets from enterprise customers; inconsistent triage causes missed SLAs and engineer context-switching.
- Customers need predictable timelines for access changes (entitlements, SSO rollouts) that impact launch plans and audits.

Scope:
- Intake classification model that assigns a priority score from signals: customer tier, org size, user roles affected, regulatory scope (data residency), change type (RBAC role creation vs full org provisioning), SSO provider complexity, existing SCIM sync status, and recent incidents.
- Canonical response templates and SLA matrix for each score band (Acknowledgement, Triage ETA, Resolution ETA, Escalation path).
- Integration touchpoints: support ticket system (Zendesk), account teams (Slack + CRM), Console onboarding flow (guided request button), and audit logging for compliance.
- Pilot with 5 enterprise customers before broader rollout.

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- Intake pipeline can assign score and suggest an SLA band for 90% of incoming admin tickets in the pilot.
- Templates for initial response and required customer artefacts (SAML metadata, user lists, SCIM mappings) are created and approved.
- End-to-end flow documented in Confluence with runbook for manual override and emergency escalation.

Trade-offs and design notes:
- Automate classification where signals are reliable (account tier, SCIM sync status) but keep human-in-loop for role-modeling and sensitive privilege grants.
- Conservative default for privilege changes to reduce over-permissive rollouts; will require additional account remediation step which increases lead time.
- Short-term MVP handles classification + templated responses; longer-term we can add guided UI and automatic SCIM-based remediation.

Metrics and success signals:
- % of admin tickets with SLA assigned within 30 minutes of receipt.
- Time to first meaningful response.
- Reduction in hand-offs from support -> infra -> security.
- Pilot customer satisfaction score >= 4/5.

Deliverables:
- Classification ruleset + scoring rubric (CSV)
- Response templates (initial ack, info request, escalation)
- Confluence runbook and operator checklist
- Pilot evaluation report and backlog for phase 2
